title: Face and the 2D Adaptive Outside plan: air entries through the shared entry rule, Adaptive lifts with a named reason (identical output)

labels.name: P2
labels.description: Main is broken or a regression with no workaround; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Part of #3743. Builds on step 1 (#3750). Step 9 of the migration.

## What happens

Two air entries exist now, each with its own code:
- Face: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/face_entry.rs:40` (`air_lead`), called from `crates/app/src/operation/plunge_solid.rs:55`.
- 2D Adaptive Outside: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive/air_rings.rs:74` (`plan_from_air`), `pocket_hsm.rs:341-372` (`air_plan`, `in_air`), `pocket_hsm_start.rs:44-55`.

The 2D Adaptive spiral (`adaptive/mod.rs:209`) and its lifts (`adaptive/lift.rs:114`, `microlift.rs:104-141`) are a different algorithm with constant engagement. They stay. Only the entry rule and the lift reason are shared.

## Fix approach

1. `ring_entry` takes the air law of these two codes (step 1 made the rule). Face and the Adaptive Outside plan call `ring_entry` for the air entry.
2. The Adaptive lifts tally their reason with `LinkTally::lift`, as the ring ops do.
3. Remove the own air code when no caller is left.

## Pins (equivalence)

- The CL moves of `crates/app/tests/adaptive_pass_start.rs`, `crates/motion/tests/face_blend.rs`, `crates/motion/tests/face_holes.rs` and `crates/app/tests/face_pass_start.rs` are the same as on the head before this change.
- The verifier verdicts and the gouge checks do not change.

Related: #2759 (Adaptive Outside order is not stable). This step does not fix it.

Effort `high`: two ops move to the shared entry rule, under the safety floor. Priority P2: a consolidation with identical output.

Done means: Face and the 2D Adaptive enter in air only through `ring_entry`, and the pins are green.
